blurb: Arizona Biltmore Golf Club offers two golf courses: the Estates Course redesigned by Tom Lehman and the Links Course. They provide golf lessons, group and corporate events, and an indoor golf simulator lounge called No. 37 Golf Lounge. The club also has dining options including Adobe Bar & Grille and The Pantry grab-and-go market.
extraNote: Credit card required for tee time reservation; cancel at least 48 hours in advance to avoid charge · Rain checks given if less than 13 holes played; 9-hole rain check if more than 4 holes played · No outside food or beverages allowed on property · Fivesomes not permitted; groups accommodated as threesomes and twosomes · One cart per twosome, two carts per foursome; no extra carts for non-players · Clubhouse, Golf Shop and parking lot on Biltmore Estates Drive
